summary: Package exports an inert OpenSSL-encrypted blob with no in-package decrypt or execute path
details: index.js re-exports `desKey` from apps/docs/app/theta.js, which reads apps/docs/app/des.db (approximately 48 KB) with readFileSync and returns its UTF-8 contents. The file's leading bytes `U2FsdGVkX1` decode to the OpenSSL `Salted__` header, indicating a base64-encoded AES/OpenSSL ciphertext. The package ships no lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) and contains no decrypt, eval, exec, Function-constructor, vm, or subprocess path that would turn the ciphertext into executable code. Installing or requiring thedata does not itself execute the blob; the payload is inert unless a separate consumer supplies an out-of-band key and decrypts and executes it. The shape is consistent with staging content for a second-stage loader that would live in a different package, but no installer-side harm is demonstrable from this package alone.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
